typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select CAST(A.MedicaidID as NVARCHAR(14)) as MedicaidID 	,CAST(A.ProgramCode as NVARCHAR(2)) as ProgramCode 	,CAST(A.StatusCode as NVARCHAR(2)) as StatusCode                   ,CAST(A.KYHealthIND as NVARCHAR(8)) as KYHealthIND 	,CAST(A.EnrollmentStartDate as DATE) as EnrollmentStartDate 	,CAST(A.EnrollmentEndDate as DATE) as EnrollmentEndDate  From EXTRACT.KY_Enrollment_MFI_Elig_Member_Extract A',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		EnrollmentStartDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MedicaidID as string,
		EnrollmentEndDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		KYHealthIND as string,
		StatusCode as string,
		ProgramCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EnrollmentStartDate,
		MedicaidID,
		EnrollmentEndDate,
		KYHealthIND,
		StatusCode,
		ProgramCode)) ~> FlatFileDestination
